thread:
AlertBot: Multiple 5xx and per-token latency anomalies detected in eu-west-1 runtime pools at 18:02 UTC. Auto-created incident 1792345678.
Maya Gomez: Observed latency + error spike affecting gen endpoints for a subset of EU customers. Initial graphs show sudden drop in cache hit ratio.
Ethan Cho: Digged into mcache logs: large eviction bursts correlated with a write surge from a single client session pattern. eviction_rate jumped ~9x at 18:01.
Ravi Kapoor: Hot mitigation plan: 1) throttle eviction trigger thresholds, 2) disable prefetch in eu-west for 15m, 3) route strict-SLO customers to companion quantized models. Applying now.
Support Lead: Notifying affected accounts (IDs redacted) and CS on workaround. Sending template note to AEs for outbound.
Maya Gomez: Applying live config: `runtime.cache.prefetch=false`, `cache.eviction.window_ms=2000` on blue pool. Canary on pod eu-w-21.
Ethan Cho: Canary metrics: cache_hit up from 61% -> 84% in 90s, 5xxs down ~55%. No service crashes.
AlertBot: Canary rollout complete on eu-w-21.
Ravi Kapoor: Rolling hotfix (rev: hotfix-evict-2026-03) across all eu-west pools. Staggered 30s intervals.
Support Lead: CS prep: if customers ask, message: "We had transient inference degradation due to cache eviction storms; mitigations in place; performance restored for most customers." Waiting PR review for public status.
Maya Gomez: Monitoring dashboard: 11/12 pools back to baseline. One pool (eu-w-11) still showing elevated latency; investigating operator-level I/O saturation.
Ethan Cho: Investigating eu-w-11: found pod stuck in high write-back loop due to a bad client pattern. Killed pod and let controller recreate; pod restarted at 18:25 UTC.
Ravi Kapoor: Full rollout completed at 18:30 UTC. Post-deploy checks green.
StatusBot: Created incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1792345678 (public update pending).
Maya Gomez: Impact: customer-visible but contained; classifying severity S2.
Support Lead: Public status draft ready: "We experienced degraded performance in eu-west-1 caused by a cache eviction storm triggered by a high-write pattern. Mitigations applied and service restored for most customers. Postmortem forthcoming." Approve to publish?
Ravi Kapoor: Approve. Publish after 10m to allow final confirmation.
Ethan Cho: Owner for postmortem: Maya Gomez. ETA initial postmortem draft: 72hrs. Include action items: client rate-limiting, stricter eviction backoffs, and improved alerting on eviction deltas.
AlertBot: Alerts suppressed at 18:35 UTC; will reopen if thresholds exceed configured limits.
Support Lead: Final internal note: mitigated, monitoring, CS outreach ongoing. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/cache-eviction-handling
StatusBot: Public message queued and will go live at 18:40 UTC: "Resolved: EU-west degraded inference due to cache eviction storm; mitigations in place. For customers still seeing issues contact support@redwood.ai." :white_check_mark:
